card: Adds microbenchmarks for BIP-352 Silent Payments public key extraction (GetPubKeyFromInput). It establishes throughput baselines for standard input types (P2PKH, P2SH-P2WPKH, P2WPKH, and P2TR key-path) and measures worst-case performance under maximally malleated P2PKH scriptSigs. This provides performance regression tracking during ongoing updates to silent payments input validation.
evidence: PR description points to recent and ongoing changes to GetPubKeyFromInput (#36338, #36417) making performance tracking desirable.
Benchmark measurements in the PR description show standard inputs take ~2.8 to 3.0 µs, whereas a maximally malleated consensus-valid P2PKH scriptSig takes ~69.9 µs (~23x slower).
problem: Silent Payments input parsing and key extraction logic has seen ongoing bug fixes and refinements, but developers lack benchmarks to measure execution overhead or detect regressions in standard and worst-case scenarios.

risk.why: Touches only benchmark harness code and has no effect on node runtime, wallet execution, or consensus.

scope_notes: Benchmark code only; adds new test cases to the benchmarking suite.
summary: Adds microbenchmarks for BIP-352 Silent Payments public key extraction using GetPubKeyFromInput. It measures execution performance across standard input types (P2PKH, P2SH-P2WPKH, P2WPKH, and P2TR key-path) as well as an adversarial worst-case P2PKH input with a maximally malleated scriptSig.
